must name one of gap/amplitude/source leg/test leg/tau/product/tail/wall/projection/direct product

failure_rule: reject unsourced templates and toy numbers

reject rows with no observable map

failure_rule: reject promoting a bound anchor into an MTS prediction

zero rows need an explicit parent-signed theorem and boundary/readout silence
failure_rule: reject post-hoc setting of beta, tau, c_g, or q_loc to zero

requirement: this validator is a private nonclaim gate before any local score
